summary: Registers the owner's 2026-10-01 decision to support paper channels for all disciplines (WoS, PubMed, CNKI, Wanfang and others) with saved login sessions. ADR 0010 records the four channel tiers, per-project discipline presets with global credentials, the Keychain vault and its threat model, the stdout/stdin login bridge, the guarded background session search the owner chose (provisional daily caps, unapproved), the PDF resolver chain and CJK handling. Adds R-CHANNELS and R-CREDENTIALS, the not_run evaluations E-CHANNELS, E-CREDENTIALS and E-CJK-RANKING (E-CJK-RANKING also gates R-DISCOVERY), tasks CHAN-00..CHAN-11, a sources entry with recheck date for every channel, and short scope notes in PRODUCT, DOMAIN, ARCHITECTURE (new outbound data: project keywords to enabled channels, contact email to polite pools), FEASIBILITY, RESEARCH, AGENTS and HANDOFF.
scope_note: Docs and harness registration only, in worktree branch worktree-channels; no app, Rust, prompt or budget code changed. Sources entries were checked against documentation only; none records a live call. Session-search caps in ADR 0010 are provisional and need owner approval.

budget_impact.rationale: No runtime code changed. The planned channels are metadata HTTP calls with zero model tokens; their request budgets are registered per task and measured later.
budget_impact.after: Zero model tokens; unchanged runtime until CHAN-02.

checks.note: The first run in the evidence file failed only because this change record did not exist yet; re-run after writing it passed.
296 of 320 passed; the 24 errors are HTTP tests whose localhost bind the agent sandbox blocks (EPERM), same as baseline. No code changed in this unit.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; read the full diff, checked that every new requirement has a task and gates, every new evaluation is referenced and not_run, and that no doc claims a live call or measurement.

open_risks: Background session search may breach CNKI and other sites' terms and get the owner's account or campus IP range blocked; guards only lower the chance.
Provisional session-search daily caps (10/30, CSSCI 5/15; hard 30/100) are unapproved.
Channel facts (quotas, key requirements, endpoints) come from documentation read on 2026-10-01 and may change; session-channel endpoints are not yet observed.
Critical class needs an independent review before release; none was run for this docs-only unit.
